whenToUse: People must find their way back from a language switched by mistake.
There are so many languages that search is needed.
whenNotToUse: There are only two languages (use a toggle link).
You'd force a language based on location alone.

alternatives.name: Combobox
alternatives.reason: Choosing from a list while typing.

accessibility: Each language name has a lang attribute, so it's pronounced in that language.
The search field is type="search", and a message is read when nothing matches.
Options are radio buttons, moved through with the arrow keys.
